grouping.description: The grouping ID without file extension (e.g., 'cc-8')

observation.description: What you observed from pre-processed docs, vision tool calls, and which sheets were considered. Document what you saw before making a determination.

reasoning.description: How your observations align with the checklist deficiency text. Explain why your observations drive your conclusion, whether the sheets analyzed were correct, and any implicit or unstated assumptions.

tools_used.description: Names of tools invoked while evaluating this item (e.g., 'vision', 'semantic-search-blocks'). Empty array if no tools were called.

explanation.description: Brief (6-30 word) explanation of the determination — what was found or not found

resolution.description: For fail: specific corrective action the applicant must take. For pass/not-applicable: null.

resolutionDetails.description: Optional structured resolution data for rich UI rendering. Only for verbatim/standard note failures.

type.description: The kind of structured resolution data.

expected.description: The full expected standard note text from the checklist.

actual.description: The text actually found on the submitted plan.

referenceUrl.description: URL to the official reference document (e.g., CoA standard notes template).

documentId.description: Document ID from site plan README.md

sheetNumber.description: Sheet number within the document, if applicable

evidenceLocations.description: Where evidence was found (for pass) or where it was expected but missing (for fail). Empty array for not-applicable.

summary.description: One-sentence summary: X of Y items pass, Z items fail, etc.
